intended use: SM_VolcanicRock_A (dark jagged volcanic rock ~4 m) - PRIMARY. Dark near-black columnar basalt block with pale mineral veins/lichen, faceted jagged silhouette. Authored in centimetres: imports at 406 x 394 x 662 Blender units (= 4.1 x 3.9 x 6.6 m if read as cm) -> scale ~0.006 for a 4 m tall rock. 23.1k tris (decimate to ~15k).

  Sketchfab_model transform (Y-up, scale) - apply transforms and re-pivot to base-centre in the dai pipeline.
